records.quote:
Although this study replicated the results of previous
studies (e.g., Strand and Eldevik 2018) limitations can
be noted.
records.reason: The authors explicitly say this study replicated previous studies and identify Strand and Eldevik (2018) as an example; the supplied shipped-original list instead identifies DOI 10.1002/jaba.106. This is positive retesting evidence, though the passage does not specify which component of the earlier finding was retested.

The authors state that two reported results replicate the previous findings with Le Pelley’s paradigm and cite the exact 2015 paper. The shipped list contains Watson et al. (2019), a distinct study, not the Le Pelley original.

records.quote: This replication study using data from 13 cohorts around the world confirmed our previous findings that persons with major depressive disorder show advanced brain aging compared to controls by approximately +1 year.
records.reason: The paper explicitly describes an independent replication and says it confirmed the previous brain-aging finding associated in the source with Han et al. (2021a). Its shipped list instead gives DOI 10.1016/j.biopsych.2018.02.061, a different work.
